'''Camp Can'ali''' was a [[Jawa/Legends|Jawa]] trading camp on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Tatooine/Legends|Tatooine]]. At one point during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]], the camp was located southeast of [[Mos Ila]], though the Jawa tribe who lived in the camp soon moved their [[Sandcrawler/Legends|sandcrawler]].
